w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Peyton is calling it "Old Gavel." Nobody agrees yet — weigh in if you want.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 💥 The attack finds you — no dodging it.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

loss.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
